meaning.zh:
“怒气冲冲” 或 “准备开战”。

这个短语最初源自于北美印第安人的文化，以描述他们准备好发动袭击或参与战争的状态。现代英语中，“on the warpath” 常用于比喻一个人非常生气，准备采取行动表达愤怒或报复。
meaning.en: This phrase originally comes from Native American culture in North America, describing their readiness to launch an attack or engage in warfare. In modern English, "on the warpath" is often used figuratively to describe someone who is very angry and ready to take action in expressing their anger or seeking revenge.

lines.en: Watch out, the boss is *on the warpath* today after the project failed.
lines.zh: 当心，老板今天怒气冲冲，因为项目失败了。

lines.en: My mom was *on the warpath* when she found out I broke her vase.
lines.zh: 妈妈发现我打破了她的花瓶时，真是怒气冲冲。

lines.en: Be careful, John is *on the warpath* after he lost the game.
lines.zh: 小心点，约翰在比赛失败后怒气冲冲。
